__comment: Kafka와 Iceberg metadata 관측. stream-storage-observer가 PostgreSQL pipeline_run_metrics에 append-only flush한 실제 snapshot만 읽는다. Iceberg table scan과 관측 실패를 0으로 위장하는 쿼리는 금지한다.
title: Orc Citadel · Stream & Lake

panels.title: Kafka probe freshness — 마지막 성공 이후 경과(m)
panels.description: Kafka Admin API가 마지막으로 성공한 시점. 3분을 넘으면 consumer lag 값도 신뢰하지 않는다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM now() - max(recorded_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "경과(m)" FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'kafka_probe_ok' AND value = 1

panels.title: Kafka consumer group — stable
panels.description: promotion consumer group의 마지막 Kafka Admin state. 0은 STABLE이 아닌 상태, No data는 관측 부재다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT value AS stable FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'kafka_consumer_group_healthy' ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Iceberg probe freshness — 마지막 성공 이후 경과(m)
panels.description: REST catalog metadata를 마지막으로 읽은 시점. 3분을 넘으면 table snapshot 값은 과거 상태다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((extract(epoch FROM now() - max(recorded_at)) / 60)::numeric, 1) AS "경과(m)" FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'iceberg_probe_ok' AND value = 1

panels.title: Iceberg table probe — 현재 상태
panels.description: 각 table metadata load 결과. 0은 table 단위 관측 실패이며 metrics 0이 아니다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table') labels->>'namespace' AS namespace, labels->>'table' AS table_name, value::integer AS ok, recorded_at FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'iceberg_table_probe_ok' ORDER BY labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table', recorded_at DESC

panels.title: Kafka consumer lag — topic 합계
panels.description: promotion consumer group의 committed offset과 log end offset 차이. 0은 측정된 무적체, No data는 probe 실패 또는 group 미배정이다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", labels->>'topic' AS metric, value FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'kafka_consumer_lag' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Kafka assigned partitions
panels.description: consumer group에서 현재 committed offset을 가진 partition 수. 가동 중인데 0이면 assignment 또는 초기 consumer 상태를 확인한다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", value AS assigned_partitions FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'kafka_consumer_group_partitions' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Iceberg current snapshot — records · data files
panels.description: 현재 snapshot summary의 total-records와 total-data-files. table scan 없이 Iceberg metadata에서 읽는다.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table', metric) labels->>'namespace' AS namespace, labels->>'table' AS table_name, metric, value FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric IN ('iceberg_current_snapshot_records', 'iceberg_current_snapshot_data_files') ORDER BY labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table', metric, recorded_at DESC) SELECT namespace, table_name, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'iceberg_current_snapshot_records') AS records, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'iceberg_current_snapshot_data_files') AS data_files FROM latest GROUP BY namespace, table_name ORDER BY namespace, table_name

panels.title: Iceberg snapshot count — 현재
panels.description: 각 table의 metadata snapshot 수. 지속적으로 가파르게 증가하면 compaction/commit 단위를 점검한다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table') labels->>'namespace' AS namespace, labels->>'table' AS table_name, value::integer AS snapshots, recorded_at FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'iceberg_snapshot_count' ORDER BY labels->>'namespace', labels->>'table', recorded_at DESC

panels.title: Iceberg current snapshot age
panels.description: 현재 snapshot의 commit 시각 이후 경과. 새 기록이 있어야 할 table에서 계속 증가하면 promotion path가 멈춘 것이다.

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS "time", labels->>'namespace' || '.' || labels->>'table' AS metric, value FROM pipeline_run_metrics WHERE metric = 'iceberg_current_snapshot_age_s' AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY 1
